verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's marketing claims 'no proxy headaches, just clean data' implying built-in handling of anti-bot issues, but a hands-on community comment explicitly states Firecrawl lacks a proxy service, calling it 'the heart of any crawler and scraper' that's missing. No first-party docs describe a rotating proxy pool feature. Missing for 10: explicit docs on proxy rotation configuration, independent confirmation of proxy pool usage, and resolution of the community contradiction.
